svg.title: Exercise 5.2.7 incremental small-signal equivalent
svg.desc: Voltage source vs through Rsi drives input vi. Input resistances Rb 300 kilohms and rbe 890.265 ohms are parallel to ground. Output has controlled incremental current beta ib from collector to grounded emitter, collector resistor 2 kilohms and load 4 kilohms parallel to ground. Input and output voltages are ground referenced.
